steps.text:
In **Paul K. Benedict (1972) *Sino‑Tibetan: A Conspectus***, seven specific prefixes receive individual chapters. These are the core Proto‑Sino‑Tibetan prefixes identified in the work:

| Prefix | Chapter title (as listed in the table of contents) |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------|
| **s**  | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed s‑* |
| **r**  | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed r‑* |
| **b**  | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed b‑* |
| **g**  | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed g‑* |
| **d**  | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed d‑* |
| **m**  | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed m‑* |
| **a**  | *Tibeto‑Burman prefixed a‑* |

These seven chapters (plus a general chapter on prefixes) constitute the only sections of the monograph that are dedicated solely to individual prefixes of the hypothetical Proto‑Sino‑Tibetan language.
